description: This file defines a Perl class 'Coocook::Schema::Component::Result::Boolify' that customizes how boolean columns are stored and retrieved in a database schema, ensuring values are stored as 1 or 0.

classes.name: Coocook::Schema::Component::Result::Boolify
classes.description: A class that extends DBIx::Class::FilterColumn to handle boolean columns, ensuring they are stored as 1 or 0.
